description: Mark all four existing flat-net vertices at which three numbered faces already meet. The targeted error is treating this local three-face junction set as the complete set of folded cube corners, missing seam corners that require remote free boundaries to join. The four local sums are9,7,11,9, so their maximum is11 instead of14.
